SELECT t_materiel.id, t_materiel.`status`, t_materiel.materiel_no AS materielNo, t_materiel.materiel_name AS materielName, t_materiel.materiel_level AS materielLevel, t_materiel.product_class_no AS productClassNo, t_materiel.product_class_name AS productClassName, t_materiel.sku_no AS skuNo, t_materiel.sku_name AS skuName, t_materiel.unit, t_materiel.manufacturer_code AS manufacturerCode, t_materiel.manufacturer_name AS manufacturerName, t_materiel.executive_standard AS executiveStandard, t_materiel.standard_number AS standardNumber, t_materiel.erp_materiel_no AS erpMaterielNo, t_materiel.erp_materiel_name AS erpMaterielName, t_materiel.erp_materiel_showdesc AS erpMaterielShowdesc, t_materiel.tax, t_materiel.receipt_name AS receiptName, t_materiel.receipt_matriel_type AS receiptMatrielType, t_materiel.org_no AS orgNo, t_materiel.org_name AS orgName, t_materiel.dept_no AS deptNo, t_materiel.dept_name AS deptName FROM t_materiel WHERE t_materiel.is_deleted = #{param.deleted}
AND t_materiel.`status` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.status}, '%')
AND t_materiel.materiel_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.materielNo}, '%')
AND t_materiel.materiel_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.materielName}, '%')
AND t_materiel.materiel_level LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.materielLevel}, '%')
AND t_materiel.product_class_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.productClassNo}, '%')
AND t_materiel.product_class_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.productClassName}, '%')
AND t_materiel.sku_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.skuNo}, '%')
AND t_materiel.sku_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.skuName}, '%')
AND t_materiel.unit LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.unit}, '%')
AND t_materiel.manufacturer_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.manufacturerCode}, '%')
AND t_materiel.manufacturer_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.manufacturerName}, '%')
AND t_materiel.executive_standard LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.executiveStandard}, '%')
AND t_materiel.erp_materiel_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.erpMaterielNo}, '%')
AND t_materiel.erp_materiel_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.erpMaterielName}, '%')
AND t_materiel.erp_materiel_showdesc LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.erpMaterielShowdesc}, '%')
AND t_materiel.tax LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.tax}, '%')
AND t_materiel.receipt_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.receiptName}, '%')
AND t_materiel.receipt_matriel_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.receiptMatrielType}, '%')
AND t_materiel.org_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.orgNo}, '%')
AND t_materiel.org_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.orgName}, '%')
AND t_materiel.dept_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.deptNo}, '%')
AND t_materiel.dept_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.deptName}, '%')
ORDER BY t_materiel.gmt_modified DESC
